title: The graded horseshoe middle map has factorizable compatible defects
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be abelian [def-sp-abelian], $S=(A\xrightarrow f B\xrightarrow g C)$ short exact, $T=(A\prime\xrightarrow{f\prime}B\prime\xrightarrow{g\prime}C\prime)$ short exact, and $F=(a,b,c):S\to T$ a morphism of short complexes. Choose injective resolutions [def-sp-injective-resolutions] $I_A,I_B,I_C,J_A,J_B,J_C$ of these six objects, with augmentations $i_A,i_B,i_C,j_A,j_B,j_C$, and chain maps $\alpha:I_A\to I_B$, $\beta:I_B\to I_C$, $\alpha\prime:J_A\to J_B$, $\beta\prime:J_B\to J_C$. Require the rows to be degreewise short exact, the composites $\beta\alpha$ and $\beta\prime\alpha\prime$ to vanish, and $\alpha i_A=i_Bf$, $\beta i_B=i_Cg$, $\alpha\prime j_A=j_Bf\prime$, $\beta\prime j_B=j_Cg\prime$. Let $\varphi_A:I_A\to J_A$, $\varphi_C:I_C\to J_C$ be chain maps with $\varphi_Ai_A=j_Aa$ and $\varphi_Ci_C=j_Cc$. There are graded maps $\chi^n:I_B^n\to J_B^n$, $E^n:I_C^n\to J_A^{n+1}$ and $e:C\to J_A^0$ with $\chi^n\alpha^n=\alpha\prime^n\varphi_A^n$, $\beta\prime^n\chi^n=\varphi_C^n\beta^n$, $d_{J_B}^n\chi^n-\chi^{n+1}d_{I_B}^n=\alpha\prime^{n+1}E^n\beta^n$, $\chi^0i_B-j_Bb=\alpha\prime^0eg$, $d_{J_A}^{n+1}E^n+E^{n+1}d_{I_C}^n=0$, and $E^0i_C=d_{J_A}^0e$.

source.place: Weibel Theorem 2.4.6, graded splitting and defect factorization; Stacks Tags 0136 and 013T

proof.text: Split the source and target rows degreewise by ShortExact.splittingOfInjective. With a source retraction r and target section s prime, set chi^n = r^n ≫ phiA^n ≫ alpha prime^n + beta^n ≫ phiC^n ≫ s prime^n. The retraction, section and zero-composite identities give both outer squares.

Set D^n = chi^n ≫ d_JB^n - d_IB^n ≫ chi^{n+1}. The chain-map identities give alpha^n ≫ D^n = 0 and D^n ≫ beta prime^{n+1} = 0. Apply Exact.desc to the source row, cancel its epic beta, then apply Exact.lift to the target row. This gives E^n with D^n = beta^n ≫ E^n ≫ alpha prime^{n+1}.

Define w = i_B ≫ chi^0 - b ≫ j_B. The augmentation equations, outer squares and the two squares of F show f ≫ w = 0 and w ≫ beta prime^0 = 0. Lift w through alpha prime^0, cancel this monomorphism to show the lift vanishes on f, and descend through g using exactness of S. The resulting e satisfies w = g ≫ e ≫ alpha prime^0.

Expand D^n ≫ d_JB^{n+1} + d_IB^n ≫ D^{n+1}; it is zero by d squared = 0. Substitute the factorizations, move the differentials past alpha prime and beta using their chain-map identities, then cancel the epic beta^n and monic alpha prime^{n+2}. This gives the cocycle equation. Finally i_B ≫ D^0 = w ≫ d_JB^0 by the two augmentation differential identities. Substitute both factorizations, cancel g and alpha prime^1, and obtain i_C ≫ E^0 = e ≫ d_JA^0.
